criteriaLedger.identity: Exact positive existing CustKey/ProdKey only; never rematch by name or rewrite aliases/keys.
criteriaLedger.names: Refresh names including cleared DisplayName; preserve quantities, price, units, conversion factors, manual flags, savedAt and completion/delivery status.
criteriaLedger.restore: Restored and late analysis snapshots show current catalog names; name refresh must not invalidate completed-work fingerprint or allow repeat distribution.
criteriaLedger.failure: Failed current-master read never reports a successful current snapshot; preserve existing mappings and show refresh failure.
criteriaLedger.history: Keep original pasted/base-stock text and historical audit snapshots unchanged; no automatic mapping or ERP writes.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 same week retain original year, customer/product keys, quantities and completed status while display names refresh; same name with different key never redirects.
